title: Ashen Crown Protype
author: Evolve_Solo
selftext:
Ashen Crown (Prototype!!!) - [Ashen Crown by Mago-oq](https://mago-oq.itch.io/ashen-crown)

What if you became the ruler of a falling demon empire?

Ashen Crown is a narrative RPG simulator and anime visual novel hybrid, where you play as the new ruler of a demon empire that has dominated for a long time, but now everything is falling apart. As the ruler, you have to listen to ministers, manage your state, make hard ethical and strategic decisions, deal with different factions, conquer new territories and decide what kind of ruler you want to become. Will you rule with justice and prove that the prejudices against demons are wrong? Or will you become the tyrant everyone always feared demons to be?

The game is inspired by Yes, Your Grace and Volcano Princess. It focuses on narrative choices, dialogue, kingdom management, political drama, character interactions and the feeling of ruling a realm that is close to breaking. Your decisions influence the empire, the people around you and the future of your rule. Every choice can make you look stronger, weaker, merciful, cruel, wise or dangerous.

(important note!!!)

This version of the game is only a prototype and an early look at the tone, characters, basic ideas and gameplay direction, so please expect rough edges, placeholder art and changes in the future. The game is currently planned for PC.

About AI (important note!!!)

We use AI as a development tool for Ashen Crown, mainly for placeholders, quick concepts, mood exploration and visual brainstorming. For us, AI has been extremely helpful during the early development phase. It allows us to test ideas faster, explore different art directions, communicate the intended atmosphere more clearly, and keep the project moving even without a full art budget yet. That said, our long term goal is not to rely only on raw AI generated assets for the final game. Important final artwork, character sprites, UI assets and key visuals are planned to be refined, redrawn, replaced or created by real artists when we have the possibility and budget.
